title: Adrafinil – keep a lid-closed Mac awake only while agents work
claim: Show HN: Adrafinil – keep a lid-closed Mac awake only while agents work
why_good: Keeps a lid-closed Mac awake only while agents are actually working — a neat, specific fix for running agents overnight.
value: A cheap paid Mac utility for people running long agent jobs; niche but clear.
risk: Tiny utility (Amphetamine/Caffeine territory); easily cloned, and Apple could change power APIs.

zh.claim: Show HN: Adrafinil —— 仅在 agent 干活时,让合盖的 Mac 保持不休眠。
zh.why_good: 仅在 agent 真正工作时让合盖的 Mac 不休眠——给跑通宵 agent 的人一个利落、具体的解法。
zh.value: 给跑长 agent 任务的人卖个便宜的 Mac 小工具;细分但清晰。
zh.risk: 极小工具(Amphetamine/Caffeine 的地盘);易被抄,Apple 也可能改电源 API。
